sync.error.bad_feed: The server sent changes in an order that cannot be right. Nothing was changed on this device.
sync.error.bad_request: The server did not accept the request.
sync.error.blocked: A change to this item was refused. Discard that change to edit the item again.
sync.error.conflict: This item was changed somewhere else. Your change was not saved and is kept as a draft.
sync.error.damaged: This item cannot be opened. The last good version is kept.
sync.error.draft_unreadable: A saved change could not be read.
sync.error.epoch_mismatch: The server's key generation does not match this vault.
sync.error.gone: The list of changes could not be brought up to date. Try again later.
sync.error.idem_reuse: The server refused to repeat this change.
sync.error.missing_on_server: The server does not show this item. It is kept on this device and uploaded again.
sync.error.quarantined: The server says this item is deleted, but that could not be checked. The local copy is kept.
sync.error.quota_exceeded: The vault is full. Delete something and try again.
sync.error.storage: This browser could not save the change on this device.
sync.error.upload_again_failed: This item could not be prepared for upload again.
sync.state.unauthorized: Sign in again to go on
sync.warning.missing_on_server: The server's list did not show some items. They are kept on this device and uploaded again. Nothing was deleted.
sync.warning.rev_lower_than_local: The server showed an older version of an item than this device has. It was ignored.
sync.warning.rev_same_row_changed: The server showed a different item under a version this device already has. It was ignored.
sync.warning.row_damaged: An item from the server could not be opened. The last good version is kept.
sync.warning.server_behind: The server is behind this device. It may have been restored from a backup. Changes made on this device meanwhile may not show after a restart.
sync.warning.server_restored: The server was restored to an earlier state.
sync.warning.tombstone_unverified: The server says an item is deleted, but that could not be checked. The local copy is kept.
sync.warning.unexpected_rev: The server saved a change under an unexpected version number.
